data.long_meaning: Derived from the French Robin, meaning 'little Robin', this name holds a soft and gentle appeal. Robin is a popular bird name, symbolizing freedom, joy, and renewal. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Robinette usually hope their child will grow to embody little robin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
